semantics.cycle: One change-directed implementation cycle may cover a coherent cluster of related changes; it counts as one attempt in the campaign ledger.
per_change_obligations_retained: Each member change keeps its own proposal/design/tasks artifacts and its own acceptance checks and retained evidence
Acceptance criteria and required gates are never narrowed, waived, or merged across changes
Sync and archive remain per change and only after that change's acceptance passes
semantics.ledger: One attempt entry per cluster cycle, listing every member change, its acceptance results, and any member left unfinished with the blocking condition

inventory_basis: inventory.json (47 active changes; 44 with zero checked tasks; 521 open tasks; 23 checked)
unchanged_boundaries: Molten repository only unless the prerequisite-chain authorization applies
No dependency or toolchain pin changes
No frozen fixture or historical archive/evidence rewrites
No remote publication without separate authorization
No host GC reconfiguration, unrelated-process termination, or shared-cache deletion
Every required change acceptance gate remains mandatory
non_claims: Batching does not reduce any change's acceptance requirements
Cluster size estimates are planning aids, not commitments about implementation effort
